comparisons.peer_topic: Focus of R&D efforts on product platforms and margins
comparisons.peer_summary: R&D efforts are focused on developing mission-critical, innovative, sustainable, and higher-value product platforms that improve quality and stability. The company leverages its design capabilities to earn attractive margins by developing high value-add products in markets where innovation and reputation allow.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom disclose their strategic focus on high-performance computing and product innovation as core business drivers. AMD explicitly defines its mission to 'accelerate next-generation computing experiences' and its vision that 'high performance and adaptive computing is transforming our lives.' Broadcom aligns with this strategic posture by stating it 'leverage[s] our design capabilities... by developing high value-add products' and focusing R&D on 'mission-critical, innovative, sustainable and higher value product platforms.' While AMD frames its strategy around the transformative impact of adaptive computing on lives, Broadcom focuses more narrowly on the financial and quality outcomes (attractive margins, quality/stability) of similar high-value, innovative R&D efforts.

sentences.text: Our Vision - High performance and adaptive computing is transforming our lives.
Our Mission - Build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences.

We focus our research and development efforts on the development of mission-critical, innovative, sustainable and higher value product platforms and those that improve the quality and stability in our broadly deployed products.
We leverage our design capabilities in markets where we believe our innovation and reputation will allow us to earn attractive margins by developing high value-add products.

peer_results.rationale: Intel's Item 1 candidates focus on manufacturing capabilities (IDM 2.0, foundry services) and leading-edge process technology assets. These topics are structurally different from AMD's Item 1 disclosure, which focuses on its corporate mission, vision, and the broader 'adaptive computing' identity rather than specific manufacturing facility strategies or foundry business models. No candidate shares the same specific topic of mission/vision statements or high-level computing experience acceleration.

comparisons.peer_summary: The company is well-positioned with HBM3E technology and is developing new memory structures, materials, and packages for next-generation products.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron frame their business strategies around developing and transitioning to 'next-generation' technologies. AMD's mission is to 'accelerate next-generation computing experiences,' indicating a focus on the broader computing ecosystem's evolution. Micron specifically positions itself with 'industry leading HBM3E technology' and states it is 'focused on developing new and fundamentally different memory structures... designed to facilitate our transition to next generation products.' While AMD's statement is a broad mission regarding computing experiences, Micron's is a specific technical strategy regarding memory architecture transitions, yet both highlight R&D and positioning for the next generation of products as a key business driver.

sentences.text: Our Mission - Build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences.
We are well-positioned with our industry leading HBM3E technology.
We are also focused on developing new and fundamentally different memory structures, materials, and packages designed to facilitate our transition to next generation products.

comparisons.peer_summary: NVIDIA has evolved from pioneering accelerated computing to becoming a full-stack computing infrastructure company with data-center-scale offerings that reshape industry.
comparisons.comparison: AMD and NVIDIA both describe their evolution and current identity as leaders in advanced computing technologies that transform industries. AMD states its mission is to 'Build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences,' emphasizing acceleration and next-generation capabilities. NVIDIA describes itself as a 'full-stack computing infrastructure company' that 'pioneered accelerated computing' and is reshaping industry through data-center-scale offerings. Both companies use the concept of 'accelerated' or 'next-generation' computing as a central pillar of their mission and identity, though NVIDIA emphasizes its shift to a full-stack infrastructure model while AMD focuses on the acceleration of experiences.

sentences.text: Our Mission - Build great products that accelerate next-generation computing experiences.
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to help solve the most challenging computational problems.
NVIDIA is now a full-stack computing infrastructure company with data-center-scale offerings that are reshaping industry.

comparisons.peer_summary: Qualcomm's corporate responsibility vision is to act as a facilitator of innovation for a sustainable, wirelessly connected world, aiming to transform industries and address societal challenges through technology.
comparisons.comparison: AMD and Qualcomm both articulate a vision centered on technology transforming lives and industries. AMD's vision is that 'high performance and adaptive computing is transforming our lives.' Qualcomm's corporate responsibility vision is to be a 'facilitator of innovation for a sustainable, wirelessly connected world,' believing its innovations help 'transform industries' and 'enhance people's lives.' Both companies use the verb 'transform' in connection with their core technology's impact on society/lives, although AMD focuses on the computing aspect and Qualcomm focuses on wireless connectivity and sustainability.

We believe that our innovations help transform industries, enhance people's lives and address some of society's biggest challenges.
